text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm, a LANE from Taiki... "Why not join us 
for a BBQ party next holiday~?" Ooh! That 
sounds like fun...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, but on that day, I'm pretty sure I 
promised Biko I'd appear in her hero show 
as Worldwide Windy...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Taiki is gonna be in the hero show too! We 
are the World BBQ Windy!! And the 
afterparty will be a BBQ party~♪
